subject: help: run shiny with sde package

messages.author: e599414d6d881d3a
messages.subject: help: run shiny with sde package
parts:
Hi,

I am just a beginner of shiny package. Maybe this question is simple to you. I am trying to design a page which can plot different stochastic differential equations based on my input by using sde.sim function. But I do not know why every time it returns the error and saying that the parameter cannot be found.

The simple version of the part of the code is like this:

 output$sdeplot <- renderPlot({
    n <- input$obs
    X0 <- input$x0
    aa <- input$d
    bb <- input$s
   
    
    d1 <- expression(aa*x)
    s1 <- expression(bb)
    X <- sde.sim(X0=10,drift = d1,sigma = s1,N=n)
    
    plot(X,main = paste("1"))
  })

Then every time it runs to the expression function, the error appears and says that it cannot find aa. I do not know why. Could anyone give me some ideas?

Thank you very much.

Yiqing
